facts.text: Jon expressed gratitude to Gina for her support and stated that losing his job was a motivating factor in pursuing his passion for dance.

evidence.quote: Thanks, Gina! I'm determined to make this studio work. Losing my job was tough but it gave me the push I needed to do what I love.

facts.text: Jon mentioned that dancing allows him to express himself and find his happy place, and that he no longer fears others' opinions about his choices.

evidence.quote: Dancing for me is like a way to express myself and find my happy place. I used to be scared to death of what people would think, but I learnt that my own happiness is the most important thing.

facts.text: Jon shared that he is teaching dance and sees his students improving, which brings him joy.

evidence.quote: Seeing my students get better at it brings me such joy.

facts.text: Gina acknowledged Jon's happiness while dancing and encouraged him to continue expressing his true self through dance.

evidence.quote: Wow Jon, you look so happy when you dance! Show the world your true self and keep dancing!
